title: Verify fixed temporal premises and typed contacts for PR5713 (no new κ)
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

This adds a standalone independent check of the fixed causal and typed-contact premises behind [Ali Romman's PR5713](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5713), using the exact original [PR5684](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5684) input. It scans all 25,451 events, emits the complete 23-entry ledger, and checks every prescribed prospective contact of field 715, including retained destination additions. It supplies no new construction, native-provider admission, complete price validation or κ gain.

The actual write to field 340 at event 11202 is nonblocking provenance. The required stability interval is `[14654,14983)`, fixed before execution and satisfied by the source. This clarifies stronger no-write wording without alleging an identity defect.

## Task and overlap

Task `p104-side-correction`, refined to `pr5713/original5684/fixed715/causal-ledger-and-all-prospective-contacts`; the complete original catalogue card is retained. Canonical base is `df0137efd35e11b4445734bf612bdd4c7ebc330c`. PR5713 is pinned at `a5348f7143f95fe0046b92b96172e30763c7d731`; original PR5684 at `d0f6fa2555410a1e23fe4191424c2097ab3d5d97`. The retained WORD is authenticated by length, SHA256 and Git blob before decoding. Implementation head is `7f94d31659b6ccbbdd302588f5bddc94e0f01941`.

This independent source/contact certificate complements the author's endpoint checks and [PR5717's caller/owned-lifetime audit](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5717). It does not repeat the author's 771 single-visit or 214 joint-visit discovery screens. Later [PR5718](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5718) claims conditional κ `.00311024570` using different helper boundary bases. This package does not validate that successor: its changed basis, event indices and owned labels prevent automatic transfer of this fixed certificate.

The branch retains the identical [PR5703 documentation repair](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5703) as a dependency, rather than introducing another shared CI change. Frozen predecessor packages and selected-result metadata are unchanged.

## Validation

Python 3.12, standard library:

```sh
python3 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-temporal-fixed-independent-audit --check-only
python3 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/p104-temporal-fixed-independent-audit --check-source-history
python3 -B research/p104-temporal-fixed-independent-audit/verify.py research/p104-temporal-fixed-independent-audit/inputs/WORD.json.gz
python3 -O -B research/p104-temporal-fixed-independent-audit/verify.py research/p104-temporal-fixed-independent-audit/inputs/WORD.json.gz
python3 -B research/p104-temporal-fixed-independent-audit/controls.py research/p104-temporal-fixed-independent-audit/inputs/WORD.json.gz
```

Direct normal and explicit `-O` runs passed with the same complete 17-field scientific projection, SHA256 `8ad201fe2ce3ebcbb0a081774790fd4511d3ecce1b5b5c1cee3dd9bde033895c`. All twelve labelled synthetic controls passed, including predecode custody rejection, hidden reads, owned continuity, a prospective-only invalid contact, unknown semantics, minimal stability and receipt validation. Negative controls must reach their exact intended predicate and site; rejection of a sufficient premise is not an actual identity counterexample. No assert-only acceptance is used.

The three portable phases took approximately 0.504, 0.705 and 1.107 seconds under serial 45/45/60-second and 512-MiB caps. Separate static review checked the recorded complete outputs, bindings and hashes without rerunning source science. Public runtime summaries are explicitly derived/privacy-filtered, with original hashes retained; sampled RSS is not an exact peak.

Final package metadata and all 27 committed payload files/source-history checks pass at the implementation head. The official export integrity check passes. One separately registered optimized replay also passed from the Git-free, read-only export with empty PATH and all 28 exported files unchanged, reproducing the full scientific projection. Local global replay planning remained incomplete because unrelated historical manifest blobs are absent from this local Git cache; no local planning pass is claimed. Hosted CI is pending.

## Credit

Credit Ali Romman for PR5713's temporal construction and author checks; Joel Pulikkan/GamingPuzzled with Claude assistance for PR5684; and the retained [PR5678](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5678), P104, native, helper, caller and compiler lineage. Apache-2.0 LICENSE and original source NOTICE are retained, with added R22 and independent-audit attribution. Prepared for Clear1nsight with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance, including separate preparation and review agents. AI checks are not independent human or proof-kernel acceptance.

## Open next questions

The package README and TASK identify the remaining emitted-word, native absolute-phase/all-width, full endpoint/owned-erasure, caller and complete-cost/compiler/outer obligations. The five inherited framework assumptions remain. A successor audit must first rebind its actual basis, event and ownership changes; this certificate supplies neither that transfer nor a new κ. The current handoff releases this bounded audit scope; further work by this team is paused.
